independent_audit: PASS for scoped mathematical claims; bibliography/exposition corrections and external-source caution supplied in audit/AUDIT.md and AUDIT_ADDENDUM.md
strongest_scoped_result: For every n>=5, at least n-1 cocircular points suffice for two distinct occurring distances of multiplicity at most n, counting unordered pairs.
credited_countercontrol: The exact 61-point CDL specialization has minimum and second-largest multiplicities 63 and diameter multiplicity 21; it obstructs that candidate selection, not the target conjecture.

equivalent_record.scope: Its first assertion with n>=5 restored matches the target; its diverging-number assertion is additional unresolved scope.

freeze_policy: Author and independent audit bytes preserved without silent alteration. Historical pending/no-remote-write states describe those freezes; the later audit is the current scoped result assessment.

completion_estimate.interpretation: Work-scope completion only, not correctness probabilities or progress percentages toward a general proof.

duplicate_checks.limits: Bounded indexed queries and direct main attempt-directory inventory; excludes deleted, unindexed, inaccessible and private work. Not a novelty claim.

publication_boundary: Authored proofs, code, audits, generated certificates/results, immutable safe archives and public verification metadata only. No source PDFs, extracts, source images, raw corpora, selected source records or private coordination. Draft PR only; no merge, release, DOI or outreach.
